directAnswer: To print from an iPhone, ensure your printer is AirPrint-compatible and connected to the same Wi-Fi network as your iPhone. Use the Share icon in an app to access the Print option.
summary: Printing from an iPhone is straightforward with AirPrint-compatible printers. Follow the steps below to print documents or photos directly from your device.

sections.heading: Getting Started with AirPrint
sections.body: AirPrint is Apple's built-in printing solution that allows you to print wirelessly from your iPhone. Make sure your printer supports AirPrint and is connected to the same Wi-Fi network as your iPhone.

sections.heading: Steps to Print from Your iPhone
sections.body: Follow these steps to print documents or images from your iPhone.

steps.title: Open the Document or Image
steps.detail: Launch the app containing the document or image you want to print.

steps.title: Access the Share Menu
steps.detail: Tap the Share icon (a square with an upward arrow) typically located at the bottom of the screen.

steps.title: Select Print
steps.detail: Scroll down and select 'Print' from the options.

steps.title: Choose Your Printer
steps.detail: Tap 'Select Printer' and choose your AirPrint-enabled printer from the list.

steps.title: Adjust Print Settings
steps.detail: Set the number of copies, page range, and any other options, then tap 'Print' in the top right corner.

faqs.question: What should I do if my printer is not appearing?
faqs.answer: Ensure your printer is turned on, connected to the same Wi-Fi network as your iPhone, and supports AirPrint.

faqs.question: Can I print from any app?
faqs.answer: Most apps that support document sharing will allow you to print, but some may not have the Print option available.

faqs.question: What if my printer does not support AirPrint?
faqs.answer: You may need to download the printer manufacturer's app, which often provides printing capabilities for non-AirPrint printers.

caveats: Not all printers support AirPrint, so check your printer's specifications.
